Name: Duq'arael-A New NPC from Arknights
Author: Aquaasa
Description:
(English version below)

已完成，但还会继续更新，会有更多的事件或者cg补全。

中文版记得下载音乐包，不然没有事件！音乐包在小孩美化的可选文件里

QQ群：1021374641

翻译人员：[url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/mintlemonsoda?gameId=1303]mintlemonsoda的个人资料 - Nexus Mods[/url]
CG图：佚名（有两位）画师：行走图 ：米画师 小無（[url=https://www.mihuashi.com/profiles/438315?role=painter&relayId=mb24g4al-v7onf2s68q8]小無 的主页 - 米画师[/url]）

安装流程：

文件名[CP]Duq'arael或星露谷-血魔大君杜卡雷mod

使用方法：

1准备n网尾号999的高清前置mod和尾号为1915的前置mod，下载完毕并装入游戏内mod文件夹后，打开尾号999的高清前置mod文件夹，打开Portraiture文件，打开Portraits文件，鼠标右键新建文件夹，并改名为由英文字符或数字等组成的文件夹。

2 [CP]Duq'arael下载完成后解压到mod文件夹内，打开[CP]Dup'arael打开其中的高清肖像图文件夹，复制两个图片。

3将复制好的图片粘贴在你新建的文件夹内。

4进入游戏，mod成功安装，在对话窗口按P键，切换高清头像。

5完成

目前小孩美化移植到尾号32194的mod里，小孩长大能直立行走后，用在罗宾的商店购买的剪刀，装备后左键点击小孩，选择贴图覆盖。


最喜欢的物品：骨笛
喜欢的物品：五彩碎片、兔子的脚、黄水仙、翡翠、钻石、遗失之书、装饰用扇子、红之盛宴、花卉类
讨厌的物品：比目鱼、蓝色史莱姆蛋、红色史莱姆蛋、紫色史莱姆蛋

目前行程：（已修改）
星期一、三：全天在自己地图里。
星期二、四、六、日：7:00~7:50 巴士站7:50~9:20 小镇 9:20~18:00 煤矿森林树下 22:00 回家睡觉。

0心事件在煤矿森林10：00~18：00 角色处于煤矿森林时触发。（1张可视CG）
2心事件在他自己家触发
4心事件也在他自己家触发
5心事件在法师塔触发
6心事件在他自己家触发（1张CG）
8心事件在他的独立地图上触发，要求在交往状态
10心事件在煤矿森林触发（1张CG）12心事件在农场触发（1张CG）
14心两个事件 分别在晴天和雨天在农场触发（共3张CG）

看过未带兔子脚的修罗场事件且在结婚条件下，在他家里触发事件，建议带兔子脚规避掉。
特殊离婚后事件：在医院工作时间段触发，条件是和杜卡雷离婚，只会触发一次，再次离婚后不触发
安装费奥多尔·弗拉基米罗维奇·拉齐萨尔mod：选项二会有不同对话，选项一对话和未安装一样。
已与伴侣厨房mod适配特殊对话 [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/47833]Post-Marriage Spouse Shared Kitchen and Meta Dialogue Mod at Stardew Valley Nexus - Mods and community[/url]
-------------------English Description--------------------

[font=Comic Sans MS][color=#f4cccc][size=4][b]❗Since v2.2.0, the BGM has been moved to a separate Dependency Mod to avoid re-downloading huge audio files every time the main code updates. Refer to the requirement section to download the music pack.❗

[/b][/size][/color][/font]-----------------------------------------------------------

This mod is fully playable, with a complete schedule, heart events, and dialogues.  
Additional CGs and story events are planned in future updates :)

The entrance to his custom map is located above the bus stop, step into the magic circle to enter it. 

For the CG room added in 2.0.9, you'll need to walk around the (left) eye area to exit.

[b][font=Arial][color=#ea9999][size=4]For more details and gameplay hints, refer to the PDF guide in the mod folder.[/size][/color][/font]
[/b]

Likes[/b]: Prismatic Shard, Rabbit's Foot, Daffodil, Emerald, Diamond, Ornamental Fan, Red Plate, All types of Flowers

[spoiler]

Stays on his own custom map all day

7:00–7:50 — Bus Stop

7:50–9:20 — Town

9:20–18:00 — Under the tree in Cindersap Forest

Returns home to sleep at 22:00

(There can be slight changes in schedules in the latest version, refer to guide.pdf for full details.)[/spoiler]

[b][size=4][color=#e06666]Events:[/color][/size][/b]
[spoiler]
0 Hearts: In Cindersap Forest (10:00–18:00, when he's there). (1 CG)

2 Hearts: At his home

4 Hearts: Also at his home

5 Hearts: At the Wizard's Tower

6 Hearts: At his home (1 CG)

8 Hearts: On his personal map, must be dating

10 Hearts: In Cindersap Forest (1 CG)

12 Hearts: On the farm (1 CG)

14 Hearts: Two separate events on the farm — one during sunny weather, one during rainy weather (3 CGs total)[/spoiler]



[u]The child retexture has been ported to the mod [/u][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/32194]Sarkaz's Children[/url].
Once your child becomes toddler, purchase a pair of scissors from Robin’s shop. Equip them, then left-click on the child and select the option to overwrite the sprite.
